children: Czech consumer prices rose 1.9% on a yearly basis in August, putting the month-on-month inflation rate at 0.3%, statistics office data showed on Thursday.
The year-on-year inflation rate picked up from 1.7% in July. The final figures confirmed the statistics office's flash estimates released earlier this month.
NOTE. The average rate of inflation over the past 12 months was 2.0%.
